Streaming chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks are yielded and assembled correctly from the Converse streaming API

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"max_tokens":32,"messages":[{"content":"Count to three, one word per response.","role":"user"}],"model":"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0","stream":true}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let stream = client.chat_stream(req).await.expect("call failed");
    let chunks: Vec<_> = tokio_stream::StreamExt::collect::<Vec<_>>(stream).await
        .into_iter()
        .map(|r| r.expect("stream item failed"))
        .collect();
    println!("{:?}", chunks);
}
```
